creator: Alexander Terp
description:
HerdrClient::DEFAULT_TIMEOUT is 500ms (crates/muster-herdr/src/client.rs:55). A timeout at the Muster to herdr seam is not treated as I do not know - it is turned into an answer, and which wrong answer you get depends on the path.

## Scope, after round 2

The **read path is handled**: fetch_snapshot moved off the 500ms budget, and the silent attach it caused is a_2LO4kETFT.

What remains is the **write path**, and it is the worse half. intent.rs uses client.request() throughout, untouched. handler.rs:1360 renders a failure as "the daemon did not make that change: {detail} Nothing about the session moved" - a flat claim that nothing happened, which is false when the request landed and only the answer was lost.

**A bigger number does not fix this one.** A timed-out write may have landed, so "nothing moved" is the wrong claim at any timeout. That is what separates it from the read path, where a longer budget genuinely helps.

## How it was seen, three times in one round

- An integrator sent a pane message to a worker. muster pane send exited 1 with the refusal above. The message had arrived - the worker read it and replied about it. The bug was reported by the command that demonstrated it.
- A second worker hit Declined("timed out") on workspace creation in daemon_settings and spent time treating it as a flake in its own work.
- A third found the read-path half from the other direction while measuring the flake family.

This is the same contract break as a_2L1AEIpIY one seam further in. a_2I7Acusq4 established that exit 0 without submitting is a bug because the exit code is the only thing a script can read; a_2L1AEIpIY is a lost answer at CLI to window; this is a lost answer at Muster to herdr, and it is worse than either because it does not merely fail to confirm - it asserts the negative.

## The cost, which is why it is a card

Separating timed out from refused gives the seam its first failure a caller can branch on, so every current caller of a timeout-capable request has to decide what it does with a third case. The slot that found it declined to smuggle that into a card about exit codes, which was the right call.
title: muster pane send still reports a delivered message as refused, at the herdr seam
